close_reason: Triage complete for 4 of 5 scan modes (46 findings). PKIX-szmo.2 RFC scan remains open/blocked on API credits — not a blocker for triage of completed scans. 3 duplicates, 4 new fix beads filed (PKIX-6p6p/6cp5/cf0b/hk56), 39 dismissed. Report: reports/skoll-triage-summary.md.
description: After all 5 scan types complete (.2-.6), triage findings across all reports. Steps: (1) Collect all JSON outputs from /tmp/skoll-review-*.json. (2) Deduplicate findings that appear in multiple scan modes (e.g., a timing issue found by both security and consttime). (3) Cross-reference against existing beads — some findings may already be tracked (e.g., PKIX-7f92 crypto-security audit, PKIX-tit4 truststore review). (4) Dismiss false positives with documented rationale. (5) For real findings: assess severity (P0-P4), file individual fix beads with acceptance criteria, and wire dependencies. (6) Write a summary triage report at reports/skoll-triage-summary.md documenting what was found, what was dismissed, and what was filed. Consider running 'skoll multi all --no-synthesize' if the individual scans don't capture cross-cutting concerns.
title: Triage Skoll findings — deduplicate, assess, file fixes
